text:
sara_support: FYI customer AcornMaps reporting large spike in rerank p95 and lots of 5xx/gateway timeouts for their tenant. Started ~2026-03-16T14:10Z, sustained ~20m. They say it coincides with a nightly indexing job that kicks off a bulk re-rank. Getting 504 gateway timeouts and 502 from ranker-prod-02.

mike_sre: Can you paste a couple of exemplar request_ids + any elapsed timings? Also what client-side retries are they using?

sara_support: sample: x-request-id=acorn-20260316-1, backend=ranker-prod-02, upstream_status=502, gateway_elapsed=10001ms. Another: acorn-20260316-7 backend=ranker-prod-02 upstream_status=504 gateway_elapsed=10000ms. Customer says client QPS ~1200 and the payload is large (candidate_count ~500 per call). Retries are standard 3x immediate.

mike_sre: Immediate mitigation: ask them to reduce candidate_count and add exponential backoff (jitter) to retries. I'll check gateway timeout config — default 10s might be too low during overload/backpressure. Also rate-limit the tenant at the gateway temporarily.

tony_eng: Looking at trace snippets, ranker-prod-02 shows heavy KV cache contention: many requests fan out and block on the same shard, causing request queueing and eventual 5xx. We recently changed the autoscaler heuristics in canary but that should help capacity not contended locks. Short-term: reduce candidate_count to <=200, and set client concurrency to <100. Long-term: we need prefix-level caching and per-shard request semaphore to avoid global queue stalls.

jen_prod: +1 on tenant rate-limit. I'll open a support-side rate-limit rule for AcornMaps at 300qps and notify them. Can we confirm if Dedicated pool would prevent this (they're on hosted)?

sara_support: Customer asked about Dedicated — we gave ballpark but they need pricing. For now they've accepted trying candidate_count=200 and reducing parallelism.

deploy-bot: autopilot: canary rollout autoscaler-tune v2 -> 30% at 2026-03-16T13:58Z; correlated increase in scaling activity between 13:58-14:05Z.

mike_sre: Action list for support thread: 1) apply temporary tenant throttle (300 qps) 2) bump gateway timeout to 30s for that route (to reduce client retries causing retry storms) 3) ask customer to reduce candidate_count and add jittered/backoff retries. I'll make the throttle change now.

tony_eng: Engineering follow-ups: 1) add per-shard semaphore to ranker to limit concurrent requests hitting the same KV shard 2) implement a fast-fail for candidate_count > 400 with a clear 4xx so clients don't retry blindly 3) add metric for KV lock wait time so we can alert earlier. I'll open PRs for the fast-fail + metric.

sara_support: Repro steps I gave the customer to validate locally: curl example below (they repro'd in staging):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"query":"pizza near me","candidates":[{"id":1},{"id":2} /* ... ~500 items ... */]}'
```

sara_support: They ran with 500 candidates and 10 concurrent workers, got 50% 5xx. With 200 candidates and 3 workers, success rate ~98%.

jen_prod: I've created support ticket SUP-2026-492 and assigned priority P1 for the tenant-impacting SLA risk. Notifying account team and sales.

mike_sre: After throttle applied, we're seeing gateway 5xx drop by ~80% for that tenant in last 5m. Customer notified. Leave open until we deploy fast-fail and semaphore.

tony_eng: I'll target a hotfix for fast-fail this week and instrument KV lock latency. If we see recurring similar tenants, recommend offering Dedicated with pre-warmed shards.

sara_support: Customer ok to proceed with the mitigations for now. They will test overnight with reduced candidate_count and report back in the morning. I'll update SUP-2026-492 with log snippets and the temporary throttle window.

mike_sre: Great — marking this thread as escalated to eng. Closing chat loop here, tracking in ticket. :white_check_mark:
